ISO27001:5.1: Evidence management integration, resource provision, communication and support, not only policy signature.

ISO27001:6.1.1: Connect context to risks/opportunities, integrated actions and effectiveness evaluation.

ISO27001:6.3: Control planned management-system changes, not just software changes.

ISO27001:7.5.3: Control access/use, preservation/legibility, versions, retention/disposal and needed external documents.
ISO27001:8.1: Operate processes against criteria; preserve execution records, change consequences and external-process control.

ISO27001:9.2.1: Audit conformity to both local and standard requirements plus effective implementation/maintenance.

ISO27001:10.1: Demonstrate improvement of management-system suitability, adequacy and effectiveness.
